\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can say a concession, permission, an obligation, as per and a role.}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ഇളവ്} (iḷavŭ)}{ഇളവ് (iḷavŭ)}]{\ml{ഇളവ്} (iḷavŭ) — a concession; an exemption}

\label{lesson:ML-C444-ilavu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a limit, then the Malayalam for a deadline.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ഇളവ്}}
\textbf{\ml{ഇളവ്}} — \emph{iḷavŭ} — \textquotedblleft{}a concession; an exemption\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{പാവപ്പെട്ട} \ml{കുട്ടികൾക്ക്} \ml{ഫീസിൽ} \ml{ഇളവ്} \ml{ഉണ്ട്}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pāvappeṭṭa kuṭṭikaḷkkŭ phīsil iḷavŭ uṇṭŭ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Poor children have a concession on the fee.
\end{quote}

On something: -\ml{ഇൽ} \ml{ഇളവ്}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ഇളവ്}} (\emph{iḷavŭ}) is native Dravidian: DEDR 510 lists Malayalam \emph{iḷavu}, \textquotedblleft{}leave, holiday, rest\textquotedblright{}, beside \emph{iḷekkuka}, \textquotedblleft{}to slacken, to remit\textquotedblright{}. A concession slackens a rule.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{iḷavŭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{iḷavŭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pāvappeṭṭa kuṭṭikaḷkkŭ phīsil iḷavŭ uṇṭŭ.} — Poor children have a concession on the fee.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a limit, then the Malayalam for a deadline, then say \emph{iḷavŭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ഇളവ്} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A concession; an exemption\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{അനുമതി} (anumati)}{അനുമതി (anumati)}]{\ml{അനുമതി} (anumati) — official permission; consent}

\label{lesson:ML-C444-anumati}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a deadline, then the Malayalam for a concession.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{അനുമതി}}
\textbf{\ml{അനുമതി}} — \emph{anumati} — \textquotedblleft{}official permission; consent\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{യോഗം} \ml{നടത്താൻ} \ml{പോലീസ്} \ml{അനുമതി} \ml{നൽകി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{yōgaṁ naṭattān pōlīsŭ anumati nalki.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The police gave permission to hold the meeting.
\end{quote}

A formal word beside the everyday \ml{അനുവാദം}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{അനുമതി}} (\emph{anumati}) is borrowed from Sanskrit \emph{anumati}, \textquotedblleft{}assent, permission, approval\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{anumati}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{anumati}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{yōgaṁ naṭattān pōlīsŭ anumati nalki.} — The police gave permission to hold the meeting.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a deadline, then the Malayalam for a concession, then say \emph{anumati} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{അനുമതി} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Official permission; consent\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ബാധ്യത} (bādhyata)}{ബാധ്യത (bādhyata)}]{\ml{ബാധ്യത} (bādhyata) — a liability; an obligation}

\label{lesson:ML-C444-badhyata}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a concession, then the Malayalam for official permission.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ബാധ്യത}}
\textbf{\ml{ബാധ്യത}} — \emph{bādhyata} — \textquotedblleft{}a liability; an obligation\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{കടം} \ml{വീട്ടാനുള്ള} \ml{ബാധ്യത} \ml{മകനാണ്}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kaṭaṁ vīṭṭānuḷḷa bādhyata makanāṇŭ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The obligation to repay the debt is the son's.
\end{quote}

A debt is a \ml{ബാധ്യത} in the sense of a liability.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ബാധ്യത}} (\emph{bādhyata}) is built from Sanskrit \emph{bādhya}, \textquotedblleft{}to be pressed hard, to be harassed\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), with the abstract ending -\ml{ത}: what presses on a person.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bādhyata}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bādhyata}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kaṭaṁ vīṭṭānuḷḷa bādhyata makanāṇŭ.} — The obligation to repay the debt is the son's.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a concession, then the Malayalam for official permission, then say \emph{bādhyata} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ബാധ്യത} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A liability; an obligation\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{പ്രകാരം} (prakāraṁ)}{പ്രകാരം (prakāraṁ)}]{\ml{പ്രകാരം} (prakāraṁ) — as per; in the way of}

\label{lesson:ML-C444-prakaram}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for official permission, then the Malayalam for a liability.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പ്രകാരം}}
\textbf{\ml{പ്രകാരം}} — \emph{prakāraṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}as per; in the way of\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{കരാർ} \ml{പ്രകാരം} \ml{കമ്പനി} \ml{പണം} \ml{തിരിച്ചു} \ml{നൽകണം}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{karār prakāraṁ kampani paṇaṁ tiriccu nalkaṇaṁ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
As per the contract, the company must pay the money back.
\end{quote}

It follows the noun: \ml{കരാർ} \ml{പ്രകാരം}, as per the contract. A formal partner of \ml{അനുസരിച്ച്}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{പ്രകാരം}} (\emph{prakāraṁ}) is borrowed from Sanskrit \emph{prakāra}, \textquotedblleft{}a sort, a manner\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 8435): in the manner of.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prakāraṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prakāraṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{karār prakāraṁ kampani paṇaṁ tiriccu nalkaṇaṁ.} — As per the contract, the company must pay the money back.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for official permission, then the Malayalam for a liability, then say \emph{prakāraṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{പ്രകാരം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}As per; in the way of\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{പങ്ക്} (paṅkŭ)}{പങ്ക് (paṅkŭ)}]{\ml{പങ്ക്} (paṅkŭ) — a role; a share}

\label{lesson:ML-C444-panku}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a liability, then the Malayalam for as per.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പങ്ക്}}
\textbf{\ml{പങ്ക്}} — \emph{paṅkŭ} — \textquotedblleft{}a role; a share\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ആ} \ml{വിജയത്തിൽ} \ml{അവളുടെ} \ml{പങ്ക്} \ml{വലുതാണ്}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ā vijayattil avaḷuṭe paṅkŭ valutāṇŭ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Her role in that victory is big.
\end{quote}

To share is \ml{പങ്കുവെക്കുക}; to take part, \ml{പങ്കെടുക്കുക}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{പങ്ക്}} (\emph{paṅkŭ}) is native Dravidian, from the verb root \emph{paku}, \textquotedblleft{}to divide\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 3808). A role is one's share of the work, and \ml{പങ്കെടുക്കുക}, to take part, is to take one's share.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{paṅkŭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{paṅkŭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ā vijayattil avaḷuṭe paṅkŭ valutāṇŭ.} — Her role in that victory is big.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a liability, then the Malayalam for as per, then say \emph{paṅkŭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{പങ്ക്} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A role; a share\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 437–444 — a review}

\label{lesson:ML-R444-review-437-444}



\begin{quote}
Say the Malayalam for formal mathematics and economics.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item formal mathematics, economics, philosophy, knowledge, studies
  \item to grasp, to memorise, to give training, to interpret, to define
  \item to quote, to summarise, to conclude, a reference, an author
  \item a condition, a stipulation, a proviso, if not, or else
  \item possible, impossible, to make possible, in that case, most probably
  \item a risk, a precaution, to predict, to estimate, a consequence
  \item to affect, to influence, an alternative, a limit, a deadline
  \item a concession, official permission, a liability, as per, a role
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Formal mathematics? (\textbf{\ml{ഗണിതം}}, \emph{gaṇitaṁ}.) Economics? (\textbf{\ml{സാമ്പത്തികശാസ്ത്രം}}, \emph{sāmpattikaśāstraṁ}.) Philosophy? (\textbf{\ml{തത്വശാസ്ത്രം}}, \emph{tatvaśāstraṁ}.) Knowledge? (\textbf{\ml{വിജ്ഞാനം}}, \emph{vijñānaṁ}.) Studies? (\textbf{\ml{പഠനം}}, \emph{paṭhanaṁ}.) To grasp? (\textbf{\ml{ഗ്രഹിക്കുക}}, \emph{grahikkuka}.) To memorise? (\textbf{\ml{ഹൃദിസ്ഥമാക്കുക}}, \emph{hṛdisthamākkuka}.) To give training? (\textbf{\ml{പരിശീലിപ്പിക്കുക}}, \emph{pariśīlippikkuka}.) To interpret? (\textbf{\ml{വ്യാഖ്യാനിക്കുക}}, \emph{vyākhyānikkuka}.) To define? (\textbf{\ml{നിർവചിക്കുക}}, \emph{nirvacikkuka}.) To quote? (\textbf{\ml{ഉദ്ധരിക്കുക}}, \emph{uddharikkuka}.) To summarise? (\textbf{\ml{സംഗ്രഹിക്കുക}}, \emph{saṁgrahikkuka}.) To conclude? (\textbf{\ml{ഉപസംഹരിക്കുക}}, \emph{upasaṁharikkuka}.) A reference? (\textbf{\ml{അവലംബം}}, \emph{avalambaṁ}.) An author? (\textbf{\ml{ഗ്രന്ഥകാരൻ}}, \emph{granthakāran}.) A condition? (\textbf{\ml{വ്യവസ്ഥ}}, \emph{vyavastha}.) A stipulation? (\textbf{\ml{നിബന്ധന}}, \emph{nibandhana}.) A proviso? (\textbf{\ml{ഉപാധി}}, \emph{upādhi}.) If not? (\textbf{\ml{ഇല്ലാത്തപക്ഷം}}, \emph{illāttapakṣaṁ}.) Or else? (\textbf{\ml{അല്ലാത്തപക്ഷം}}, \emph{allāttapakṣaṁ}.) Possible? (\textbf{\ml{സാധ്യമായ}}, \emph{sādhyamāya}.) Impossible? (\textbf{\ml{അസാധ്യമായ}}, \emph{asādhyamāya}.) To make possible? (\textbf{\ml{സാധ്യമാക്കുക}}, \emph{sādhyamākkuka}.) In that case? (\textbf{\ml{അങ്ങനെയെങ്കിൽ}}, \emph{aṅṅaneyeṅkil}.) Most probably? (\textbf{\ml{മിക്കവാറും}}, \emph{mikkavāṟuṁ}.) A risk? (\textbf{\ml{അപകടസാധ്യത}}, \emph{apakaṭasādhyata}.) A precaution? (\textbf{\ml{മുൻകരുതൽ}}, \emph{munkarutal}.) To predict? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രവചിക്കുക}}, \emph{pravacikkuka}.) To estimate? (\textbf{\ml{കണക്കാക്കുക}}, \emph{kaṇakkākkuka}.) A consequence? (\textbf{\ml{അനന്തരഫലം}}, \emph{anantaraphalaṁ}.) To affect? (\textbf{\ml{ബാധിക്കുക}}, \emph{bādhikkuka}.) To influence? (\textbf{\ml{സ്വാധീനിക്കുക}}, \emph{svādhīnikkuka}.) An alternative? (\textbf{\ml{ബദൽ}}, \emph{badal}.) A limit? (\textbf{\ml{പരിധി}}, \emph{paridhi}.) A deadline? (\textbf{\ml{സമയപരിധി}}, \emph{samayaparidhi}.) A concession? (\textbf{\ml{ഇളവ്}}, \emph{iḷavŭ}.) Official permission? (\textbf{\ml{അനുമതി}}, \emph{anumati}.) A liability? (\textbf{\ml{ബാധ്യത}}, \emph{bādhyata}.) As per? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രകാരം}}, \emph{prakāraṁ}.) A role? (\textbf{\ml{പങ്ക്}}, \emph{paṅkŭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
